pipeline_evals.description: End-to-end and per-agent evaluation test cases for the PR Agent pipeline
pipeline_evals.test_methodology: Three scenarios per agent: good_fit, stretch_fit, bad_fit

end_to_end.description: Full pipeline on RiseUp financial advisory launch — Israeli fintech, Hebrew, strong data, clear zeitgeist connection
end_to_end.expected_outcome: Complete pipeline through Step 10. Brief leads with economic data, not product. Article in Gad Lior voice. Guardian scores 9+.
assertions: brief subject line contains a number, not a company name
brief contains no forbidden words (תקציב, ריסון, צמצום, הידוק חגורה, חיסכון בכוח, ויתור, הגבלות)
brief mentions שילוב AI ויועץ אנושי (must_include)
validated_waves.json has at least 1 lead wave with match_score >= 7
reporter_article contains at least 5 specific numbers with sources

end_to_end.description: Full pipeline on ClimbingPill V6 Breakthrough — English, niche audience (climbers), limited source material
end_to_end.expected_outcome: Pipeline completes but researchers may find thin evidence for niche climbing topic. Wave validator should flag low-confidence waves. Brief should still be coherent.
assertions: context_strategy.json has 3 theses with search queries
at least 1 wave_candidate has confidence 'medium' or 'high'
brief leads with a world problem, not ClimbingPill
brief contains no AI vocabulary (leverage, groundbreaking, seamless, etc.)

context_strategist.description: Israeli fintech launching personal financial advisory with AI+human model
context_strategist.input_summary: core_problem: financial anxiety from lack of transparency; target_audience: Israeli middle class; top_level_issue: cost of living; geo: Israel
context_strategist.expected_outcome: 3 theses with strong 'why now' connection. Search queries in Hebrew. One thesis per lens (human_pain, broken_status_quo, emerging_trend).
assertions: core_tension is one sentence and non-empty
no specific numbers or statistics fabricated (only directional claims)
search queries include Hebrew queries for Israeli geo

context_strategist.description: Niche English climbing coaching program — narrow audience, limited zeitgeist connection
context_strategist.input_summary: core_problem: climbing plateaus; target_audience: intermediate climbers V3-V5; top_level_issue: climbing performance plateaus; geo: Global
context_strategist.expected_outcome: Theses should find broader fitness/health/coaching angles. May struggle with 'why now' for a niche sport.
assertions: search queries are in English (global geo)
theses connect to broader trends, not just climbing

context_strategist.description: Product with no clear problem — a luxury watch brand launching a new collection
context_strategist.input_summary: core_problem: null; target_audience: luxury consumers; top_level_issue: null
context_strategist.expected_outcome: Agent should still produce 3 theses but connection_to_launch will be weak. This tests whether the agent can work with minimal compass data.

researcher.description: Research thesis about Israeli household financial stress — Hebrew queries, local data expected
researcher.input_summary: thesis: financial stress in Israeli middle class; lens: human_pain; geo: Israel; queries in Hebrew
researcher.expected_outcome: Finds Israeli survey data, Bank of Israel reports, local news articles. Evidence details have Hebrew sources with URLs.
assertions: at least 1 source is from an Israeli publication (.co.il or Israeli org)
limitations section is non-empty and honest

researcher.description: Research thesis about AI in financial advisory — global trend, English queries
researcher.input_summary: thesis: hybrid AI-human models emerging in fintech; lens: emerging_trend; geo: Global; queries in English
researcher.expected_outcome: Finds international reports and trend data. Should still try to anchor with local Israeli examples.
assertions: at least 1 source has date within last 18 months
no marketing pages or product announcements used as evidence

researcher.description: Research thesis that cannot be substantiated — looking for evidence that doesn't exist
researcher.input_summary: thesis: climbing gyms have replaced therapy for anxiety treatment; lens: human_pain; queries about climbing therapy
researcher.expected_outcome: Agent should report low confidence honestly, not fabricate evidence. Limitations should explain what was searched and not found.
assertions: no fabricated URLs or made-up statistics

wave_validator.description: Three strong wave candidates with clear relevance to RiseUp launch
wave_validator.input_summary: All 3 waves have high confidence, strong evidence, clear connection to product
wave_validator.expected_outcome: All 3 selected. Lead wave has match_score 8+. evidence_context_for_brief_writer is a coherent narrative.

wave_validator.description: One strong wave, one medium, one weak — tests scoring differentiation
wave_validator.input_summary: Wave A: high confidence, direct relevance. Wave B: medium confidence. Wave C: low confidence, tangential connection.
wave_validator.expected_outcome: Wave A as lead. Wave B as supporting. Wave C either broadening or rejected. Scores should reflect quality difference.
assertions: lead wave is the high-confidence one
if Wave C is selected, its match_score is significantly lower

brief_writer.description: Full Hebrew brief for RiseUp with all inputs available
brief_writer.input_summary: validated_waves (3 waves), product_profile, company_profile, raw_gold — all in Hebrew
brief_writer.expected_outcome: 200-300 word Hebrew brief. 9 sections. Leads with world problem. No AI vocabulary. No forbidden words.
assertions: word count 200-300 (core sections, excluding Key Facts and What We Can Offer)
company name not in first sentence of The Problem section
no em dashes anywhere in the document
no AI vocabulary (leverage, groundbreaking, seamless, transformative, unprecedented)
Spokesperson Quote matches a raw_gold entry verbatim
Journalist Angles section has 2 or 4 angles (never 3, to avoid rule-of-three)

brief_writer.description: English brief for ClimbingPill — thinner data, niche audience
brief_writer.input_summary: English inputs, fewer wave candidates, niche climbing topic
brief_writer.expected_outcome: Brief still follows all rules but may be shorter on evidence. Should still lead with world problem.
assertions: leads with a problem, not the product

brand_guardian.description: Review a well-written brief that follows all rules
assertions: all 10 checks listed in results table

brand_guardian.description: Review a brief deliberately written with AI patterns — em dashes, rule-of-three, AI vocabulary
brand_guardian.expected_outcome: Score below 7, instant reject triggers hit
assertions: specific AI patterns identified in notes

gad_lior.description: Economic story about cost of living — Gad Lior's core beat
gad_lior.expected_outcome: 3 הערות format. Numbers as weapons. 'אנחנו' framing. Short sentences. Cause-effect chains.
assertions: contains הערה ראשונה, הערה שנייה, הערה שלישית
each הערה contains at least 1 specific number

gad_lior.description: Pure tech story with no economic angle — not his beat
gad_lior.expected_outcome: Should either find an economic angle or flag that this isn't a fit for Gad Lior
assertions: either finds economic angle OR explicitly flags poor fit

shaul_amsterdamski.description: Story about financial literacy gap — combines data with human impact
shaul_amsterdamski.expected_outcome: עלות תועלת format. Personal opening. International comparison. Institutional failure. Hope at the end. 1200-1800 words.
assertions: opens with personal anecdote or historical analogy
contains international comparison with specific numbers
ends with hope or agency, not despair
